query: Following IP injection of Buprenex (0.1 mg/kg, as an analgesic), the skull was exposed with an incision along the midline.
matched_segment: Following IP injection of Buprenex (0.1 mg/kg, as an analgesic), the skull was exposed with an incision along the midline.

query: After the skull was cleaned, six steel watch screws were implanted in the skull, one of which served as ground.
matched_segment: After the skull was cleaned, six steel watch screws were implanted in the skull, one of which served as ground.

query: Next, a ∼1.5 mm-diameter craniotomy was drilled over left hippocampus (2.0 mm posterior to bregma and 1.8 mm lateral to the midline) and the dura was removed.
matched_segment: Next, a ∼1.5 mm-diameter craniotomy was drilled over left hippocampus (2.0 mm posterior to bregma and 1.8 mm lateral to the midline) and the dura was removed.

query: Virus was delivered through a glass micropipette attached to a Quintessential Stereotaxic Injector (Stoelting, Wood Dale, IL). The glass micropipette was lowered through the center of the craniotomy to a depth of 1.2 mm below the cortical surface.
matched_segment: Virus was delivered through a glass micropipette attached to a Quintessential Stereotaxic Injector (Stoelting, Wood Dale, IL). The glass micropipette was lowered through the center of the craniotomy to a depth of 1.2 mm below the cortical surface.

query: A bolus of 1 μl of virus (see details above) was injected at a rate of 0.05 μl/min.
matched_segment: A bolus of 1 μl of virus (see details above) was injected at a rate of 0.05 μl/min.

query: After the injection, the pipette was held in place for 10 min at the injection depth before being fully retracted from the brain.
matched_segment: After the injection, the pipette was held in place for 10 min at the injection depth before being fully retracted from the brain.

query: Tetrode signals were referenced to ground, filtered between 1 and 7500 Hz, multiplexed, and digitized at 30 kHz on the headstage (design files available at https://github.com/open-ephys/headstage/tree/master/1x32_Omnetics_Standard).
matched_segment: Tetrode signals were referenced to ground, filtered between 1 and 7500 Hz, multiplexed, and digitized at 30 kHz on the headstage (design files available at https://github.com/open-ephys/headstage/tree/master/1x32_Omnetics_Standard).

query: Mouse location was determined via IR gates at behaviorally relevant points along the track and an overhead camera monitoring a red LED mounted on the headstage.

query: At the end of training, electrodes sites were lesioned with 15 μA of current for 10 s.

query: Mice were transcardially perfused with 100 mM PBS followed by 4% formaldehyde in PBS.

query: Brains were post-fixed for at least 18 hr at 4°C.

query: 60 μm sections were mounted on glass slides with Vectashield (Vector Laboratories, Burlingame, CA), coverslipped, and imaged with an upright fluorescent microscope.

query: Viral expression was confirmed by observing EYFP expression beneath the fiber optic lesions in CA1 of all animals.

query: Expression spread ∼2 mm along the length of the dorsal hippocampus, primarily in CA1, but also in the lateral portion of CA3.
matched_segment: Expression spread ∼2 mm along the length of the dorsal hippocampus, primarily in CA1, but also in the lateral portion of CA3.

query: Labeling was strongest in the hippocampal cell layer, where parvalbumin-positive cells have the densest projections.

query: There was also expression in overlying cortex.

query: No expression was observed in the dentate gyrus.

query: Spike activity was extracted offline by thresholding the 300–6000 Hz bandpassed signal.
